description: This file contains functions for calculating costs associated with Google Vertex AI and Google AI Studio models, including cost routing based on model type, per-character cost calculations, and handling of models with >128k token usage. It is focused on cost computation logic for different model types and pricing schemes within a machine learning or AI application.

methods.name: Literal["cost_per_character","cost_per_token"] cost_router( model: str, custom_llm_provider: str, call_type: Union[Literal["embedding", "aembedding"], str], )
methods.description: Routes the cost calculation to the appropriate function based on model and call type, determining if token or character-based pricing applies.

methods.name: Tuple[float,float] cost_per_character( model: str, custom_llm_provider: str, usage: Usage, prompt_characters: Optional[float] = None, completion_characters: Optional[float] = None, )
methods.description: Calculates the cost for input prompt and output completion based on character counts for a specified model and provider, taking into account dynamic pricing above 128k tokens.

methods.name: Tuple[float,float] _handle_128k_pricing( model_info: ModelInfo, usage: Usage, )
methods.description: Internal helper to compute prompt and completion costs when model usage exceeds 128k tokens, using model info parameters.

methods.name: Tuple[float,float] cost_per_token( model: str, custom_llm_provider: str, usage: Usage, )
methods.description: Calculates cost based on token counts for prompt and completion, with special handling for models with >128k token pricing.
